Capacitr is an agentic trading and market-intelligence platform that turns the information you already watch into actionable trades. Users can subscribe to monitor specific X accounts, YouTube channels, RSS feeds, newsletters, Substack articles, websites, and other live information sources, then define the signals they care about — narratives, catalysts, sentiment shifts, technical indicators, price action, volume, momentum, volatility, and other trading/TA conditions. Capacitr continuously scans those sources, extracts relevant market-moving signals, and matches them to concrete opportunities across prediction markets and derivatives venues, including Polymarket markets and Hyperliquid perp trades.

Capacitr also gives every user a Privy-powered wallet and makes it simple to fund, bridge, and deploy capital without leaving the product. Users get access to a trading agent that can help them research markets, prepare trades, bridge funds, interact with Polymarket and Hyperliquid orderbooks, manage venue-specific funding flows, and execute approved trades on their behalf. The goal is to give users a personalized, always-on market operator: one that watches the sources they trust, detects the signals they care about, maps those signals to real tradable markets, and helps them act quickly through a secure wallet and agent-driven execution layer.
